condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: UNICEF further integrated the Country Office’s external relations functions to ensure communication, advocacy and partnerships objectives were aligned and strengthened. One key achievement was the finalization and implementation of the climate action advocacy strategy, leading to commitments by the Government of Nepal to include children’s and young people’s voices in climate action policies and plans.
